author: D4S
name: DDD reference data entry (entity, persistence, migration, read-only endpoints)
description: Adds a reference-data entity to the starter: identifier, entity with a code and an I18nText name, repository interface, EF Core configuration and repository, SQL migration script with a seed block, and a read-only HAL endpoint module. Run from the repository root.

plural.description: PascalCase plural of the entity (repository type, endpoint names, route segment, table name). Defaults to a naive pluralisation of the name: Country -> Countries, Currency -> Currencies, Unit -> Units.

migration-version.description: Version prefix of the generated SQL migration script (Vnnnn). Must be the next free, unique number in src/App.Infrastructure/Migrations: SqlMigratorTests rejects duplicates.

postActions.description: Wiring steps that dotnet new cannot perform (design section 12).

manualInstructions.text:
Two steps that dotnet new cannot inject. The example below is spelled for `-n Country`;
substitute the name you actually passed (and its plural: <Name>s by default, or the --plural you gave).

1. src/App.Infrastructure/InfrastructureServiceCollectionExtensions.cs
     add   services.AddScoped<ICountries, Countries>();   inside AddPersistence, next to the other
     repositories (App.Domain.ReferenceData is already imported there).

2. src/App.Infrastructure/Migrations/V0003__add_countries.sql
     the script is embedded automatically (Migrations/*.sql) and applied by SqlMigrator, but the version
     number is a guess: rename the file to the next free Vnnnn in that folder (or generate with
     --migration-version V0004). SqlMigratorTests requires the Vnnnn__lower_snake_case shape and a unique
     Vnnnn prefix. Replace the example seed row with the real entries, keeping the ids stable, and review the
     columns against CountryConfiguration; SchemaValidationTests diffs the database against the EF model.

Nothing else needs registering: the endpoint module (IEndpointModule) is found by MapApi(), the EF mapping
(IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>) by ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(), and the EF converter for CountryId by the
value-object convention (RegisterDomainValueObjects) — identifiers need no persistence code at all.

Then:  dotnet build -warnaserror  &&  dotnet test
